Users can optionally provide a display name for personalization, stored in the name field. The system generates timestamps for both created_at and updated_at fields, marking the initial account creation time.

Security considerations include email uniqueness validation to prevent duplicate accounts, password strength requirements following standard security practices, and immediate issuance of JWT access and refresh tokens upon successful registration. The system supports multi-device authentication from creation, with session management enabling users to access their accounts across multiple devices.

The response returns authentication tokens and basic user information, enabling immediate application use without additional verification steps. This streamlined approach reduces barriers to adoption while maintaining security standards through proper credential handling and session management.

operations.description:
This endpoint authenticates users with their email address and password credentials. The login system validates credentials by comparing the provided password against the stored password_hash in the todo_app_users table using secure bcrypt comparison algorithms. Only accounts with 'active' status are permitted to authenticate successfully.

The authentication process supports multi-device access control, allowing users to maintain concurrent sessions across up to 5 devices as specified in the authentication requirements. Successful login generates fresh JWT access and refresh tokens with appropriate expiration times. The access token provides immediate API access, while the refresh token enables token renewal without requiring re-authentication.

Security measures include protection against brute force attacks through rate limiting implementations, immediate token rotation upon successful authentication to prevent replay attacks, and comprehensive logging of authentication attempts for security monitoring. The system handles authentication failures gracefully with generic error messages that don't reveal whether email addresses exist in the system.

The login response returns the authenticated user's basic information along with the JWT token pair, enabling immediate API access for protected endpoints. The refresh token supports session persistence for up to 7 days of inactivity, balancing user convenience with security requirements. This authentication approach provides enterprise-grade security while maintaining the simple, streamlined user experience central to the todo application.

operations.description:
This endpoint refreshes JWT access tokens for users with valid refresh tokens. The system validates the provided refresh token against stored session data in related todo_app_sessions table, ensuring token authenticity and checking for token revocation or expiration. Valid refresh tokens enable issuance of new access tokens without requiring user credential re-entry.

The refresh process implements secure token rotation, invalidating the old refresh token upon successful refresh and issuing a new refresh token pair. This security measure prevents token replay attacks while maintaining continuous authentication for active users. The operation supports the specified 7-day refresh token expiration period, requiring re-authentication only after extended inactivity periods.

Token validation includes verification of token signature, expiration checking against configured TTL values, and session status validation to ensure the corresponding user account remains active. The system maintains session consistency across multiple device access, ensuring token refresh on one device doesn't invalidate legitimate sessions on other devices.

The refresh response returns new JWT access and refresh tokens along with user identification information, enabling seamless continuation of protected API operations. This operation forms the backbone of the application's session management strategy, providing secure, user-friendly authentication that balances convenience with security best practices for todo list management.

Users can modify any task field while maintaining data integrity and preventing unauthorized access to other users' tasks.

Security considerations include ownership verification to ensure users can only update their own tasks, data validation to prevent invalid updates, and proper handling of status transitions including completion timestamp recording when tasks are marked as completed.

Update an existing personal todo task with modified information including title, description, status, priority levels, and due date. This operation enables users to keep their task information current and accurate while maintaining complete lifecycle tracking.

The update process automatically records modification timestamps and handles status transitions appropriately. When a task is marked as completed, the system records the completion timestamp for productivity analytics and user reference. Users can update any task field while the system maintains data integrity and ownership verification.

Task ownership is strictly enforced - users can only update tasks they own. The operation supports all task modifications including priority adjustments, due date changes, and status updates while preserving the task's creation history and user assignment.

operations.description:
Permanently delete a task from the user's todo list by removing the task record completely from the database. This operation performs a hard delete, permanently eliminating the task data without the possibility of recovery.

The hard delete approach ensures that users can clean up their task lists completely when tasks are no longer needed. Deleted tasks are physically removed from the database, freeing up storage space and maintaining clean task management workflows.

Users should exercise caution when deleting tasks, as this operation cannot be undone. Once a task is deleted, it cannot be recovered through normal application functionality. The system does not maintain backups of individual deleted tasks.

Security considerations ensure that users can only delete tasks they own. The system validates that the requesting user has ownership rights to the specified task before allowing deletion. This prevents unauthorized access to other users' task data while maintaining proper isolation between user accounts.

The operation integrates with the todo_app_tasks table as defined in the Prisma schema. Upon successful deletion, the task is completely removed from all user-facing task lists and the database, providing a clean slate for task management.

operations.description:
Execute bulk operations on multiple tasks in a single API call for improved efficiency and user experience. This operation enables users to perform common batch actions such as marking several tasks as completed, updating priorities across multiple items, or adjusting due dates for task groups.

The bulk operation design prioritizes performance and atomic consistency, ensuring that either all requested changes succeed or none are applied. This prevents partial updates that could leave task data in inconsistent states while maintaining the integrity of user task management workflows.

Common use cases include marking multiple tasks as completed when finishing a project phase, updating priority levels for related tasks during planning sessions, or adjusting due dates when project timelines change. The operation supports flexible action types to accommodate diverse user workflows and task management patterns.

The system validates that users have ownership rights for all specified tasks before applying bulk changes. This prevents unauthorized modifications to other users' task data while maintaining proper data isolation between user accounts. The operation integrates with the todo_app_tasks table and respects all business rules and constraints defined in the Prisma schema.

The operation accepts an array of task update operations in the request body, where each operation includes the task identifier and the specific fields to be updated. All updates are applied transactionally - either all updates succeed or all updates fail to maintain data consistency.

Error handling provides detailed validation feedback for each individual task update, allowing partial success scenarios where valid updates are applied even if some individual updates fail. The response includes information about which tasks were successfully updated and which failed with specific error details for debugging purposes.

ITodoAppUser.description:
Complete user account information for the Todo application representing authenticated user accounts from the todo_app_users table.

This entity serves as the primary actor in the system with exclusive access to personal task management features stored in the todo_app_users relational model. Each user maintains complete data isolation from other accounts while supporting JWT-based authentication and session management capabilities across multiple device sessions.

The system implements modern security standards including bcrypt or comparable strong hashing algorithms for the password_hash field. This authentication credential is EXCLUDED from all API responses to maintain strict security boundaries around sensitive authentication data during user profile management and administrative operations.

Users can create, manage, and complete their personal todo tasks stored in the related todo_app_tasks table while maintaining comprehensive access controls and audit logging for enterprise-grade security compliance throughout the application ecosystem.

Enables secure user account creation with email-based authentication and optional profile personalization. The registration operation creates a complete user account with security-hardened password storage using bcrypt hashing and basic profile information for immediate system access.

Supports modern account creation patterns with email uniqueness enforcement across the entire user base and comprehensive password security through server-side hashing. The operation provides immediate account activation while maintaining enterprise security standards and enabling future profile customization for enhanced user experience.

Integrates with JWT-based authentication system for immediate access token issuance upon successful registration, enabling seamless transition from account creation to authenticated application usage. Session context fields enable comprehensive security monitoring and audit trail generation for self-registration operations.

ITodoAppTaskStatistics.description:
Comprehensive task statistics and analytics for individual user performance tracking.

Aggregates data across all user tasks to provide productivity insights and task management effectiveness metrics. Computed entirely from transactional task data with no separate storage, ensuring real-time accuracy and preventing data staleness.

Statistics include count breakdowns by task status and priority levels, completion rate calculations, overdue analysis, and temporal activity patterns. All metrics are computed from the user's personal task dataset with proper handling of soft deleted tasks for data accuracy.

These analytics help users understand their productivity patterns, identify task management strengths and areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions about time allocation and priority management. Essential for personal productivity optimization and workflow improvement.

completed_tasks.description: Count of tasks marked as completed across the entire user history. Essential metric for measuring productivity and accomplishment rate in task management activities.

completion_rate.description: Percentage of completed tasks relative to total non-deleted tasks (completed / (pending + completed)). Provides efficiency measurement showing the user's ability to close out assigned responsibilities. Calculated as fraction value between 0 and 1 for precise mathematical operations and display formatting flexibility.

high_priority_tasks.description: Count of tasks assigned 'high' priority level regardless of status. Indicates current high-priority workload requiring immediate attention and strategic focus for critical deadline management.

medium_priority_tasks.description: Number of tasks with 'medium' priority level. Represents the bulk of standard operational tasks that form the core daily workflow and workload balance for typical task management.

low_priority_tasks.description: Count of tasks designated as 'low' priority. Shows deferred or optional task inventory for flexible scheduling and resource allocation when higher priority tasks are completed.

no_priority_tasks.description: Number of tasks without specific priority assignment. Indicates unstructured task inventory that may require prioritization or represent routine tasks that don't need urgency classification.

overdue_tasks.description: Count of pending tasks with due dates that have passed the current date and time. Critical metric for deadline management and time-sensitive project tracking showing immediate attention requirements.

due_today_tasks.description: Number of pending tasks with due dates matching the current calendar date. Represents immediate daily operational commitments requiring completion before end of day to maintain project timelines and user commitments.

due_this_week_tasks.description: Count of pending tasks due within the current calendar week (Sunday through Saturday). Provides weekly workload visibility and planning horizon for effective task scheduling and resource allocation across the work week.

tasks_created_this_month.description: Number of tasks created within the current calendar month. Shows monthly task creation activity and workload initiation patterns indicating typical work volume and capture rates for new responsibilities or projects.

tasks_completed_this_month.description: Count of tasks completed within the current calendar month. Measures monthly productivity and completion rates indicating user consistency in closing out tasks and maintaining forward progress on commitments.

average_completion_time_days.description: Average number of days between task creation and completion for completed tasks. Provides insight into typical task completion speed and efficiency, calculated across all completed tasks to show general productivity patterns. Measured in days for user-friendly interpretation and long-term pattern analysis.

Statistics include total task count, completed task count, and pending task count derived through straightforward database filtering. This lightweight aggregation model supports basic dashboard analytics needs without complex computation overhead.

The statistics reflect the current state of user task management providing immediate visibility into productivity levels through measurable counts.

ITodoAppTask.IBulkResponse.description:
Response structure for bulk task operations providing comprehensive feedback on operation results and task updates.

Contains detailed information about the success or failure of bulk operations performed on todo tasks. This response type delivers both high-level summary statistics and detailed task-level results, enabling robust error handling and user feedback for bulk operations.

The response includes counts for successful operations, failed operations, and warnings, along with detailed arrays of individual task results. Each task result indicates whether the bulk operation succeeded for that specific task and provides relevant error or warning messages when operations encounter issues.

Provides both aggregated summary metrics for quick reference and granular task-level details for comprehensive debugging and user notification. This dual-level structure enables effective integration with client applications while supporting detailed error analysis and recovery scenarios.

success_count.description: Number of tasks that were successfully processed during the bulk operation. Counts only operations that completed without any errors or warnings.

failure_count.description: Number of tasks that failed to process during the bulk operation. Indicates operations that encountered errors and could not be completed successfully.

warning_count.description: Number of tasks that processed with warnings during the bulk operation. Indicates operations that completed but encountered issues requiring user attention.

total_count.description: Total number of tasks included in the bulk operation request. Sum of success_count, failure_count, and warning_count.

results.description: Individual task operation results providing detailed information about each task processed during the bulk operation. Contains success/failure status, error messages, and updated task information for each item.

has_errors.description: Boolean indicator whether any tasks encountered errors during the bulk operation. True if failure_count > 0, false otherwise. Enables quick error detection in client applications.

ITodoAppTask.IBulkResult.description:
Individual result for a specific task within a bulk operation, providing detailed status and outcome information.

Contains comprehensive information about the processing result for a single todo task within a bulk operation sequence. This result type enables detailed error handling and task-level debugging by providing specific feedback about what happened during the bulk operation for each individual task.

Tracks both the operational status (success, failure, warning) and the resulting task state after processing. Provides actionable error information when operations fail and indicates warning conditions that may require user attention even when operations succeed.

Supports detailed error diagnostics by including specific error codes, messages, and validation failures that can help users understand and resolve issues with their bulk operations.

task_id.description: Unique identifier of the todo task processed by this bulk operation. References the primary key from todo_app_tasks table.

status.description: Processing status for this individual task. Values: 'success' if operation completed without issues, 'failure' if operation encountered errors, 'warning' if operation completed with warnings requiring user attention.

error_message.description: Detailed error message explaining why the bulk operation failed for this specific task. Null when status is 'success' or contains only warnings that don't prevent operation completion.

task.description: The task object after the bulk operation was applied. Contains the updated task state when the operation succeeded, or the original state when the operation failed. Updates are applied transactionally only when all referenced tasks successfully validate.

operation_type.description: Type of bulk operation attempted for this task. Examples: 'update_status', 'delete', 'change_priority', 'update_due_date'. Enables tracking of which specific operation types encountered issues.

validation_errors.description: Array of validation errors encountered during task processing. Includes specific field names and validation messages for each constraint violation.

ITodoAppTask.IValidationError.description:
Comprehensive validation error representation for detailed task processing error analysis and debugging support.

Provides precise field-level error reporting for task data validation failures during bulk operations, enabling granular debugging of constraint violations with actionable corrective feedback for immediate user support.

Supports complex validation scenarios including format validation, constraint violations, business rule compliance, and temporal relationship validation across multiple task fields within bulk operations, ensuring complete operational transparency.

Integrates seamlessly with task processing workflows providing immediate feedback on data quality issues while maintaining detailed audit trails for error pattern analysis and system improvement initiatives through comprehensive error tracking mechanisms.

Enables efficient bulk operation debugging through detailed field identification and specific constraint violation explanations, supporting both technical developers and non-technical users in rectifying problematic task data efficiently.

field.description:
Exact field identifier that triggered the validation error during task processing operations. Identifies the specific property path within the task update operation that contains invalid or non-compliant data values preventing successful bulk operation completion.

Supports complex field path notation including nested property validation paths such as 'task.title' or 'task.priority', enabling precise targeting of data issues within structured task objects across multiple hierarchical levels for detailed error localization.

Reference field names align with validated database schema column definitions and API design patterns ensuring consistency between client-side validation, API requirements, and database constraints for comprehensive data integrity maintenance.

Provides actionable field identification enabling immediate corrective action by API consumers while supporting comprehensive error mapping and debugging capabilities throughout complex bulk operation workflows for enhanced developer productivity.

message.description:
Complete error explanation providing specific validation failure details and actionable resolution guidance. Includes comprehensive information about the violated constraint, expected value format, and practical steps for correction that enable immediate task data normalization for successful bulk update operations.

Supports multi-language capability and localized error messaging for enhanced international user experience across global task management deployments. Message content is crafted for developer accessibility while maintaining technical accuracy for precise debugging assistance throughout development and production environments.

Provides detailed breakdowns when multiple constraints are violated simultaneously, enabling comprehensive understanding of all validation issues through single error instances without requiring multiple correction cycles. Messages follow consistent formatting and professional tone guidelines for enterprise API presentation standards.

Integrates with comprehensive error tracking systems providing detailed violation context for both developer debugging and user corrective action guidance. Supports advanced error analysis capabilities including violation pattern identification and prevention strategies through comprehensive message structure design.

ITodoAppTask.IBulkUpdate.description:
Advanced bulk update request container enabling efficient transactional management of multiple todo task modifications through single API interaction for optimal performance and resource utilization.

Designed for high-performance batch operations supporting up to 100 concurrent task updates with atomic transaction guarantees ensuring consistent all-or-nothing operation success across comprehensive bulk operations. Maintains detailed operation consistency through comprehensive validation tracking and sophisticated error recovery systems.

Provides comprehensive task management capabilities including bulk status transitions, priority category adjustments, due date modifications, and content updates with complete data integrity preservation. Enables efficient productivity workflows by eliminating repetitive individual API calls while maintaining detailed operation success tracking for complete outcome transparency.

Integrates seamlessly with the todo_app_tasks database table performing optimized UPDATE operations with parameterized query constructs for maximum security, performance, and reliability. Supports complex workflow management scenarios including project milestone updates, priority reorganization, and comprehensive deadline management across large-scale task collections efficiently.

operations.description:
Ordered array of individual task modification operations within the atomic bulk update request. Supports efficient processing of up to 100 concurrently submitted task updates per transaction while maintaining operational integrity and comprehensive performance optimization through sophisticated batch processing systems.

Each operation represents an atomic field modification targeting specific task records with complete validation tracking, comprehensive error reporting, and full rollback capabilities for complete data integrity preservation. Operations execute sequentially within transaction boundaries ensuring complete consistency across all bulk modifications for reliable outcome management.

Enables partial success scenarios where valid operations complete successfully while problematic updates generate detailed error reporting for immediate debugging and retry operation support. Supports comprehensive logging and audit trail maintenance for all bulk operation activities ensuring complete operational visibility and accountability.

Optimized for sophisticated enterprise task management scenarios including project milestone tracking, priority categorization, comprehensive workflow state transitions, and deadline management across large-scale task collections while maintaining individual operation traceability and comprehensive success metrics throughout processing workflows.

items.description: Individual atomic task modification within bulk processing workflow representing targeted field update on specific task record with complete validation support and detailed error tracking systems.

ITodoAppTask.IBulkOperation.description:
Individual task update operation within a bulk update request. Specifies which task to update and what fields to change for atomic bulk operations.

Represents a single atomic update operation targeting a specific task in the todo_app_tasks table. Each operation includes the target task identifier and optional field updates with complete validation support.

Enables conditional updates where only provided fields are modified while preserving other task properties. Supports comprehensive task field updates including titles, descriptions, status, priority, and due dates.

Provides individual operation validation ensuring each update is valid before applying bulk changes. Includes error tracking for partial success scenarios where some operations succeed while others fail validation.

Integrates with the todo_app_tasks database table performing UPDATE operations with parameterized queries for security and efficiency.

id.description:
Unique identifier of the task to be updated. Corresponds directly to the id column in the todo_app_tasks table and represents the primary key for the target task.

Uses UUID format matching the database schema ensuring type consistency. Required for identifying the specific task record that will receive updates within the bulk operation.

References the todo_app_tasks table id column maintaining referential integrity. The task must exist in the database with this exact identifier for the update operation to succeed.

Serves as the primary key reference enabling precise task targeting within bulk operations while maintaining database normalization and constraint compliance.

title.description:
Updated task title. Maximum 200 characters to maintain consistency with standard task creation limits defined in the todo_app_tasks table title column.

Optional field that modifies the task's title when provided while preserving existing values when omitted. Supports title changes for task renaming, content updates, or organizational adjustments.

Validated against the table constraints ensuring consistency with single task update operations. Maintains referential integrity with the todo_app_tasks table title column maintaining data completeness.

Enables task title modifications within bulk operations providing flexible content management capabilities while preserving database schema constraints and validation rules.

description.description:
Updated task description. Maximum 1000 characters to maintain consistency with standard task creation limits defined in the todo_app_tasks table description column.

Optional field that enables description updates while preserving existing content when omitted. Supports rich text content including details, notes, and extended information about the task.

Constrained by database column limits ensuring consistency with individual task operations. Maintains referential integrity with the todo_app_tasks table description column preserving data validation rules.

Provides comprehensive content modification capabilities within bulk operations while respecting database schema boundaries and ensuring data quality through validation mechanisms.

status.description:
Updated task status. Valid values: 'pending', 'completed'. Supports localized status changes for task management workflows and lifecycle tracking.

Optional field enabling status modifications while maintaining existing statuses when omitted. Valid values match the database enumeration ensuring consistency across all task management operations.

Processes status transitions from pending to completed and vice versa with tracking support. Integrates with workflow management enabling batch status changes for task completion, reopening, or workflow state modifications.

Maintains consistency with the todo_app_tasks table status column enabling workflow management and providing completion tracking for user productivity metrics.

priority.description:
Updated task priority. Valid values: 'none', 'low', 'medium', 'high'. Supports priority adjustments for task organization and importance management.

Optional field allowing priority reassignment while preserving existing priorities when omitted. Valid values correspond to the database enumeration ensuring consistency with standard priority levels.

Enables task importance hierarchy management through batch priority changes. Supports reorganizing task priorities based on evolving needs, deadlines, or workload adjustments within bulk operations.

Integrates with the todo_app_tasks table priority column maintaining data consistency and enabling priority-based filtering, sorting, and organizational features for improved task management.

due_date.description:
Updated due date. Can be set to null to remove an existing due date from the task. Supports date-time format consistent with database timestamp requirements.

Optional field enabling due date modifications while preserving existing dates when omitted. Accepts null values for date removal providing complete date management flexibility within bulk operations.

Maintains consistency with the todo_app_tasks table due_date column format requirements. Supports date validation ensuring valid date formats and preventing invalid timestamp assignments during bulk updates.

Provides comprehensive due date management including setting, modifying, or removing due dates across multiple tasks simultaneously while maintaining database integrity and temporal consistency.

total_operations.description: Total number of update operations processed in the bulk request.

successful_operations.description: Number of operations that completed successfully without errors.

failed_operations.description: Number of operations that failed due to validation errors or other issues.

results.description: Detailed results for each individual operation, including success status and any error messages.

ITodoAppTask.IBulkUpdateResult.description: Response containing detailed results of bulk task update operations. Provides comprehensive feedback on operation success rates and individual error details for debugging purposes.

ITodoAppTask.IBulkOperationResult.description:
Result of an individual task update operation within a bulk update request. Indicates success or failure with optional error details for comprehensive operation feedback.

Represents the outcome of a single bulk operation attempt providing detailed success/failure information. Each result corresponds directly to an ITodoAppTask.IBulkOperation request with explicit status reporting.

Supports detailed error analysis through field-specific error messages enabling precise debugging of validation failures and constraint violations. Provides complete debugging information while maintaining successful operation feedback for partial success scenarios.

Integrates with validation systems providing field-level error reporting and user-friendly error messages for corrective action guidance. Maintains operation traceability through task identifier linkage ensuring complete audit trail for bulk operations.

error.description:
Error message if the operation failed. Null if the operation succeeded, providing clean success case handling without error payload noise. 

Optional field providing detailed failure information only when necessary for debugging and corrective action. Supports comprehensive error reporting including validation failures, database constraints, and operational errors. 

Enables user-friendly error messaging for field-specific validation issues and business rule violations. Maintains null return for success cases ensuring clean API responses while providing detailed feedback for error conditions.

id.description:
Identifier of the task that was attempted to be updated. Corresponds directly to the id value provided in the ITodoAppTask.IBulkOperation request, enabling clear operation-to-result mapping.

Uses UUID format maintaining consistency across the API interface. Required for tracking individual operation outcomes within bulk request processing and error identification.

Serves as the primary key reference linking results to specific bulk operation requests. Provides operation traceability within bulk requests ensuring complete feedback loops for API consumers.

success.description:
Indicates whether the update operation succeeded (true) or failed (false). Provides binary success status for efficient operation outcome determination.

Boolean value indicating operation completion status, distinguishing between successful updates and validation failures. Enables efficient filtering and processing of operation results based on success criteria.

Supports error categorization and bulk operation success rate calculation. Provides fundamental success tracking for operation metrics and debugging procedures within bulk processing workflows.

IIPAddress.description: Standardized IPv4 or IPv6 address representation for network identification and session tracking. Used across authentication operations for security monitoring and audit trail generation.

IURI.description: Standardized Uniform Resource Identifier for web address reference and audit trail tracking. Used consistently across authentication operations for source validation and security monitoring.

IEmailAddress.description: Standardized email address representation for account authentication and identification. Used consistently across authentication operations for user verification and communication.

IPassword.description:
Standardized password representation for authentication verification and security validation.

Passwords must meet security requirements including minimum length constraints and are used consistently across all authentication operations for credential validation and verification. The password field represents the user's secret authentication credential during login, registration, and password change operations.

This password string is handled securely through proper encryption and hashing mechanisms before storage. Never stored in plain text format. Used in user authentication flows including login attempts, new user registration, and password reset operations.

IRefreshToken.description:
Standardized JWT refresh token representation for maintaining authenticated sessions and enabling seamless access token renewal.

Refresh tokens provide long-lived credentials that allow users to obtain new access tokens without re-authentication, enabling persistent login sessions across application restarts and device changes. These tokens are critical for maintaining user convenience while ensuring security through token rotation and expiration management.

JWT refresh tokens contain cryptographic signatures that validate token authenticity and prevent tampering. Generated upon successful authentication and stored securely by both client and server. Used in token refresh flows to extend user sessions without requiring repeated login credentials, supporting seamless application experiences.

ITodoAppTaskMetric.description:
Individual task statistic metric with value and optional metadata for analytics display and interpretation.

Used internally by task statistics for individual metric components. Each metric value includes optional additional context information for display purposes, formatting hints, or business rule compliance indicators.

The value property contains the actual numeric metric, while context provides supplementary information about calculation methods, data quality indicators, or display recommendations.

value.description: The actual numeric value of this task metric for statistical computations, display, and productivity analysis across the user's complete task dataset.

context.description: Optional contextual information for this metric including calculation methods, data quality indicators, or display formatting hints for analytics presentation.

ITodoAppTask.IInvert.description:
Inverted task view providing user ownership context for independent task displays and task management across user accounts.

This specialized view enables administrators and users to see tasks with complete ownership context when viewing tasks outside of their normal user-scoped endpoints. Displayed when users view tasks in dashboard aggregations, administrative interfaces, or cross-user task management scenarios where ownership context is essential.

The user ownership provides essential context for understanding task assignment, permissions, and administrative control while maintaining lightweight data structure for performance. This pattern supports use cases where task identification requires understanding who owns the task.

Used in administrative task views, cross-user task comparisons, and system-wide task analytics where task ownership context is critical for proper understanding and management.

description.description: Optional detailed description providing additional task context. Supports up to 1000 characters for comprehensive task information while maintaining system performance.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the task was first created. Automatically set upon task creation for audit trail and chronological organization.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent task modification. Automatically updated whenever any task field changes to maintain accurate change tracking.

id.description: Unique task identifier for task management and tracking.

title.description: Task title describing what needs to be completed. Maximum 200 characters to ensure clarity and readability while preventing overly verbose descriptions that could impact performance.

status.description: Current task status: 'pending' for active tasks or 'completed' for finished tasks.

due_date.description: Optional due date for time-sensitive tasks. Supports realistic planning horizons up to 5 years in the future while preventing unrealistic deadline setting.

completed_at.description: Timestamp when the task was marked as completed. Records completion time for productivity analytics and user reference.

priority.description: Task priority level: none, low, medium, or high with medium as default.

user.description: Task owner summary for essential user context in cross-user task views and administrative interfaces where ownership identification is critical for proper task understanding and management permissions.
